boundary_condition: Apply this only to hotel or room amenity selection; it should not affect flight, rental car, restaurant, destination, or nearby-cafe choices.
condition: When the synthetic user is comparing or vetting hotel rooms and amenity details are part of the decision.
default_action: Prefer hotel room options that list coffee availability, and ask whether coffee or a coffee maker is available when the amenity details are unclear.
exception_condition: If coffee availability is not confirmed but the room otherwise satisfies harder stated constraints, flag or ask about the missing coffee information instead of treating the room as automatically acceptable or automatically rejecting all options.
name: Check for coffee as a hotel room amenity
rationale: Across independent hotel task dialogues, users repeatedly included coffee among desired hotel or room amenities, including one explicit in-room coffee-maker check. This supports a scoped synthetic default to check for coffee availability when hotel amenities matter, without making coffee a universal travel preference or a hard rejection rule.
